customer_statement: I raised a ticket yesterday morning and nobody has picked it up.
I have to keep emailing the service desk just to find out what is happening.
One agent told me it was resolved but the laptop still will not connect.
I had to explain the same problem three times to three different people.
I do not know who owns my ticket once it leaves the service desk.
When it is urgent I just walk over to the IT room — that is faster.
Please just tell me realistically when it will be fixed.
My ticket was closed without anyone telling me what was done.
The portal asks for information you cannot possibly know.
It gets bounced between teams and restarts each time.
